# @haruhimemoe/tourney

> osu! tournaments as data: zod schemas and pure functions for tournaments, round ladders (single and double elimination, qualifiers, grand final reset), brackets with progression and byes, qualifier seeding, stored match records, pick/ban logs checked against a @haruhimemoe/pool pool, teams with subs and lineups, captain drafts, registration and scheduling through @haruhimemoe/time. No storage, network or clock. Peers: zod, @haruhimemoe/pool, @haruhimemoe/time. ESM for Node 22.12+, Bun, Deno, browsers and bundlers.

Main exports: `buildLadder`, `createBracket`, `reportResult`, `reportForfeit`, `clearResult`, `champion`, `rankQualifiers`, `checkPickBans`, `checkScore`, `checkTeam`, `checkLineup`, `draftOrder`, `makePick`, `reviewRegistration`, `canRegister`, `suggestMatchTimes`, `checkReschedule`, `TournamentSchema`, `TeamSchema`, `MatchSchema`, `BracketSchema`. One entry point: `@haruhimemoe/tourney`.

## Docs

- [Install](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/tourney#install)
- [Quick start](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/tourney#quick-start)
- [Ladders](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/tourney#ladders): round codes and play order
- [Brackets](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/tourney#brackets): statuses, progression, reset
- [Pick/ban](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/tourney#pickban): rules and refusals
